interpretation: Diagnostic pointers overlap across request, repair and stage levels. This is not a count of independent failed generations. Request failures and failure-inclusive benchmark rates are reported separately.
partial_streams: Retained under partial_*.jsonl or interrupted_*.jsonl; early timeouts before token-level checkpointing lack complete text, as documented in RUN_LOG.md.
release_scope: Earlier development artifacts, raw requests and partial streams remain in the ignored local campaign archive. The public failure inventory retains their paths. Controlled attempts and final application records/audits are included in results/reproduction.tar.gz.
